summary: Orders at exact tier thresholds (e.g. 10 units) fail to qualify for discount tiers due to a strict inequality comparison. Changing the check in `tier_for` from strict greater-than to greater-than-or-equal enables inclusive lower bounds.
steps: Change the comparison inside the `for tier in TIERS:` loop from `if quantity > tier.min_quantity:` to `if quantity >= tier.min_quantity:`.
constraints: No file other than `pricing/discounts.py` is edited.
